title: ING-VP: MLLMs cannot Play Easy Vision-based Games Yet

live_model.evidence: "Closed-source models include GPT-4o, GPT-4o Mini, GPT-4v, GPT-4 Turbo, Claude-3.5 Sonnet, Claude-3 Opus, and Gemini-1.5 Pro" (Sec. 4.1); row GPT-4 Turbo in Table 1 (text-only columns only).

prompt.location: Appendix B (36 prompts, B.1-B.6 by setting and game)
prompt.note: System and instruction prompts printed per game and setting; text-only settings use textual level representations from the repo.

claim.location: Table 1, row GPT-4 Turbo, Text-only One-step column (6 games x 50 levels)

notes: Paper dated 2024-10-09 with no preview string, so GPT-4 Turbo resolves to the GA snapshot. Scoring accuracy requires replaying the JSON move sequence in the game simulators (Sokoban, Maze, Hanoi, n-queens, 15-puzzle, Sudoku); simulators live in the public repo, so the number cannot be checked from the prompt alone. GPT-4 Turbo was run text-only (image columns null). Overall GPT-4 Turbo accuracy 1.87 averages three text-only settings.

resolution.plan: Accuracy is decided by replaying the model's JSON move sequence in the game environment. Take the 50 text-representation levels per game (6 games) and the text-only one-step prompts of Appendix B from the repository, call gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 once per level, extract the JSON action list with the printed regular-expression rule and replay it in the repository's simulators (Sokoban, Maze, Hanoi, n-queens, 15-puzzle, Sudoku) to decide completion within the step limit; accuracy over 300 levels vs 2.30%.
resolution.approximation: Decoding parameters are not stated in the text (repository defaults assumed); the simulators must be the repository's.
